verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API documentation site, a Developer Center, and published OpenAPI/Swagger specs on GitHub. None of it documents an interactive API reference or explorer with runnable examples. The OpenAPI files are developer building blocks, and the community Postman proof of concept is a user-side workaround; neither counts as the product's own interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
